fader-full-forward.model_reference: Screening scenario: TI SLVSFN2B https://www.ti.com/document-viewer/DRV8311/datasheet/GUID-XXXXXXXX-SF0T-XXXX-XXXX-000000179401 and https://www.ti.com/document-viewer/DRV8311/datasheet/GUID-C826F7E8-19E5-47C8-9C09-E13912428538; Bourns SRP1265WA-470M small-signal Q/DCR https://www.bourns.com/docs/product-datasheets/srp1265wa.pdf; Q includes conductor and core losses https://www.coilcraft.com/en-us/resources/application-notes/key-parameters-for-selecting-rf-inductors/. 25 C driver, SLEW=01, DEADTIME=001, 0.7 V assumed diode drop; electrical-cycle sinusoidal RMS mapping; inductor temperature assumed equal to winding temperature.
